rows.label: Tenno Lab: Nami Skyla, then Okina
rows.note: 10,000 cr, 5 Gallium, 5,500 Alloy Plate, 165 Plastids, 3,250 Cryotic

conditions: The lab must be built and stocked; a solo clan funds every resource itself. Research timers run in real time, so start it as soon as the Cryotic is in.
In an established clan this is already done and costs you nothing.

groups.activity: Excavation, ideally as an endless Void Fissure

rows.label: Cryotic
rows.note: research only; the build uses none

conditions: Use the double-pickup Resource Booster, not the drop-chance one, which does nothing for Cryotic. Loyal or Resourceful Retriever also doubles it.
Excavators die easily at high enemy levels; a loot or crowd-control frame like Nekros or Khora keeps enemies off.
bonuses: A fissure cracks a relic every 200 Cryotic.
Groups report about 3,000 Cryotic in a little over 30 minutes; randoms are hit or miss.

disclosures.title: Duviri Circuit trickle
disclosures.body: Triggering the fourth excavator in Circuit pays an extra 20 to 40. Several players built up large totals this way, but dedicated farming is far faster.

groups.activity: Survival or Defense, ideally an endless Void Fissure

rows.label: Oxium
rows.note: only from Ospreys killed before they self-destruct
rows.alt: also Venus, Mars, Neptune, Pluto, Eris, Europa, Lua

rows.label: Tellurium
rows.note: rare; Archwing on Uranus, Grineer Sealab, Kuva Fortress, Empyrean

conditions: Self-detonated Ospreys drop nothing; shoot them before they reach you.
bonuses: Excavation on Corpus tilesets drops Oxium as a side reward.

groups.activity: Survival with a loot frame and a Resource Booster

rows.label: Alloy Plate
rows.note: 5,500 research + 4,200 build; Venus, Phobos, Ceres, Jupiter, Pluto, Sedna

conditions: Some players ran short of Plastids and Ferrite; check what you hold before starting research.

rows.label: Okina
rows.note: 2 Tellurium, 4,200 Alloy Plate, 3,400 Polymer Bundle, 1,800 Oxium

bonuses: Its own Mastery, separate from Okina Prime.

disclosures.title: Incarnon Genesis
disclosures.body: A separate upgrade from the Steel Path Circuit, installed through Cavalero in the Chrysalith for 20 Pathos Clamps, 20 Maw Fang and 80 Lamentus. It needs The Duviri Paradox, Angels of the Zariman and Steel Path unlocked, and does not raise the effort of getting the weapon.
